declared D_001A74D8 `volatile long` (MACRO_ADDR) with no second context writing it: the reply
pump the comment named, func_00132028, runs in the same thread. Under AGENTS.md's volatile
rule that qualifier only steered reorg: it kept the one-word store out of the `b` slot. It also
made the unit depend on the EE tree's mark_set_resources rule, under which the plain store
before it clears the volatile flag…

commits.headline: build(compiler): make GCC 2.95's set-side sticky volatile rule the default
commits.author: bigbeno37
commits.body:
mark_set_resources (resource.c) assigns `res->unch_memory = RTX_UNCHANGING_P (x)` and
`res->volatil = MEM_VOLATILE_P (x)` at every MEM it sets. reorg's backward delay-slot search
from a call (fill_simple_delay_slots) gathers what the insns it passes set, and
resource_conflicts_p rejects every later candidate once `set.volatil` is on. When the insns just
before a call are a plain store and then a volatile store, the volatile store turns the flag on
and the plain store turns it off again, so an…

commits.headline: build(compiler): keep the mtc1 hazard nop behind an unconditional branch
commits.author: bigbeno37
commits.body:
restrict_mtc1_exemption.py exempts two measured transfer pairs (mtc1 $4,$f0 before
cvt.s.w $f0,$f0, mtc1 $0,$f0 before c.lt.s $f12,$f0) from gas's hazard nop when gas has
forgotten its history, and took "both history slots empty" as the sign of that. gas empties
them in two ways. mips_no_prev_insn (md_begin, a section change, .align, data) forgets the
history: it also clears prev_insn_valid. append_insn empties both slots after every
unconditional branch (b, j, jal, jr), filled or not, and then…
